title: Practice 2: Мне нравится, нужно, надо, можно

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Нет, вам к ___ (лёт) надо настоящее зелёное, — как травка-муравка.
exercises.why: «The person who needs something (or someone) is in the dative case … The logical subject, when used with можно or нельзя, is in the dative case.» «This verb (нравиться) is used with the agent in the Dative case and the object (of the liking) in the Nominative case.» — DLI, Lessons 35, 36, 66.
